newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle sell $106/dressed, off $1-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle sell $106/dressed, off $1-USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers on a live and dressed basis mostly $1.00 per cwt lower, USDA said.
Demand and seller interest was uneven. Some buyers lowered their bids after the noon hour, when both CME and boxed beef prices moved sharply lower.
Wk To Date- 12,000 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 85,400 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 101,700
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1225-1325 lbs - 65.00-66.00; dressed basis mostly 106.00, few 105.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1225 lbs - couple loads 65.50; dressed basis 106.00.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights)
